subject: general
question:
Select the meaning of the given idiom.

split one’s sides
solution: The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"split one’s sides"** means to laugh very hard or to be extremely amused. (हंसते-हंसते पेट फटना) • **Example:** The comedian's jokes were so funny that the audience was** splitting their sides.** • **"Extremely amused"** refers to finding something very funny or entertaining. (बेहद मनोरंजन) • **Example:** The children were **extremely amused **by the clown's antics. Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is** to** **be extremely amused**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Meet with an accident** (दुर्घटना से मिलना): To be involved in an unexpected and unfortunate incident. • **Example:** He **met with an accident** on his way to work. • **Scream in pain** (दर्द में चीखना): To cry out loudly because of severe pain. • **Example:** She **screamed in pain** when she twisted her ankle. • **Undergo a surgery** (सर्जरी कराना): To have a medical operation. • **Example:** He had to** undergo surgery** to repair his broken leg. b9:Td23, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
